text:
jamie: Heads-up — LexiData (customer) is seeing repeated 400s from our function-calling path after the v3.1.7 canary started this morning. Error from API: "Function call validation failed: unexpected key 'attachments'". They said it worked on 3.1.6 and broke immediately after 3.1.7 canary reached ~25%. Ticket INC-4721.
sasha: Ack. Which model variant and rollout id? Any deploy logs?
jamie: Variant: redwood/v3.1.7-opt (quantized). Rollout id d-2398, region us-west-2. Deploy bot posted rollout ~1998879000 -> 1998880000 this morning.
miguel: Pinging @oncall to triage. Mike can you try to repro with the sample payload? :eyes:
mike: On it. Jamie, can you paste the exact failing request body from the customer?
jamie: Pasting minimal failing payload below:
```json
{"model":"redwood/v3.1.7","input":"Summarize the thread","functions":[{"name":"summarize","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}}}}],"tool_args":{"attachments":[{"name":"log.txt","size":12345}]}}
```
mike: Hitting hosted endpoint with identical body returns:
```json
{"error":"Function call validation failed","details":"unexpected field 'attachments' in tool_args for function 'summarize'"}
```
ash: Noted — schema validator is rejecting 'attachments'. On 3.1.6 the tool selection apparently matched a different function schema that tolerated an attachments array. This smells like a tool-selection / function-matching regression in v3.1.7 (fn-chooser heuristics change).
sasha: Checking other canary feedback channels — saw 2 other customers with missing tool invocations when payload includes attachments/meta. Could be model choosing 'summarize' vs 'summarize_with_meta' differently.
miguel: Repro locally with the same payload against the v3.1.7 image: stack trace shows failure in /runtime/tooling/chooser -> apply_schema: TypeError at validate_field 'attachments' -> schema mismatch.
mike: Hypothesis: v3.1.7's prompt-to-tool scoring adjusted which function it selects; selected function has stricter schema. The validator then rejects the attachments key because that function's parameters don't include it.
jamie: Customer impact: ~30% failure rate, some increased latency due to retries and a billing spike from repeated token use. LexiData flagged this as P1 for their production flows. :rotating_light:
ash: Recommend immediate rollback of v3.1.7 to v3.1.6 for routes with functions-enabled. Add canary abort if schema validation errors exceed threshold.
oncall: Initiating rollback for rollout d-2398 now.
deploy-bot: rollback started for rollout d-2398 by oncall (mike). ETA ~2m.
mike: Rolling back completed. Can someone verify LexiData's requests now?
jamie: Confirmed — after rollback customer reports calls succeed again. Logs show 200s for previously failing payloads. Updating ticket INC-4721 with status and remediation steps.
sasha: Good catch. Follow-ups: 1) Add function-call schema assertion to canary health checks (fail canary if >0.1% schema validation errs), 2) add e2e test vectors that include optional attachments/meta, 3) add a canary gating unit that checks function-selection distribution vs baseline.
miguel: I'll open a regression PR to revert the heuristic change and add tests. Also adding a short-term patch to prefer previous function-selection scoring for production routes.
jamie: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and close the loop. Creating a postmortem and cc'ing product + runtime teams. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Ticket INC-4721 updated: status=RESOLVED (rollback applied). Link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-4721
